https://mastodon.social/@gerowen/1174914.text: #Valve also seems to have updated their built-in video editor for #Steam gameplay footage to include support for in-game events. #Deadlock, for example, shows loading screens with a striped texture on the timeline, and also places markers on the timeline for all kinds of events such as kills, towers being destroyed, etc. It had markers for screenshots and achievements before, but now games themselves can mark in-game events on the timeline, so that's awesome. #Gaming #PCGaming
